en.answer: Even though both cards' names are treated as "Unknown", you can still use the ②nd effect of <<19149>>, and the ②nd effect of <<19150>>, once per turn each. (This is the same as if their name were not treated as "Unknown".)
en.question:
I control <<19149>> and <<19150>>, both of which have their names treated as "Unknown" due to the effects of <<21183>> or <<21193>>. Will I only be able to use one of their ②nd effects, due to the『You can only use the ②nd effect of [cards with this card's name] once per turn.』text?

(TL note: In the OCG, once-per-turn clauses do not specifically spell out the card's name like they do in the TCG. Instead, they only refer to "cards with this card's name", and refer to the effect(s) by number instead of "this effect", "these effects", etc.)
en.title: If there are multiple cards named "Unknown" with different original names, does『You can only use this effect of "⁜⁜⁜" once per turn.』mean that only one of the "Unknown"s can use its effect?

ja.answer: カード名が「アンノウン」として扱われている場合でも、「<<19149>>」と「<<19150>>」の②の効果は１ターンにそれぞれ１度ずつ使用できます。（カード名が「アンノウン」として扱う効果が適用されていない場合と同様です。）
ja.question: 『このカード名の①②の効果はそれぞれ１ターンに１度しか使用できない』というテキストを持つ自分フィールドの「<<19149>>」と「<<19150>>」の２体が相手の「<<21193>>」や「<<21183>>」の効果で「アンノウン」として扱われている場合、それぞれの『②』の効果はどちらか片方しか使用できなくなりますか？
ja.title: 元々のカード名が異なる「アンノウン」が複数体存在する場合、”このカード名の効果は１ターンに１度しか使用できない”効果は「アンノウン」の内、いずれか１体しか効果を使用できなくなりますか？
